contact_edits.before: The books say that Shaw was poking fun at the costume melodramas of his own day; I suspect that he also adored them, and this staging allows us the best of both worlds, spectacle worn at a rakish angle. The production is fast and easy. It's a lightweight evening. Which is both right and good. - In repertory at the Stratford Festival until Nov. 8. For tickets and information call 1-800-567-1600 or visit stratfordfestival.ca.
